_comment: Words whisper will not guess on its own, fed to it as the initial prompt.
Hinglish is English sentence structure with Hindi words inside it, written in
Latin script -- 'band karo ye gaana', not 'बंद करो ये गाना'. That matters: forcing
whisper to language=hi makes it emit Devanagari, which nothing downstream can read.
Measured on ggml-small.en with these terms: keyword recall went 21% -> 74% and the
Proper nouns carry almost all of the gain. Function words alone scored 21%; artists
alone scored 68%. The prompt is a budget, not a free-for-all -- padding it with 12
app names pushed recall back down to 68%, because the app names displaced the
artists. Add a name here only if it is one you actually say.
'artists' is a starting set of who gets asked for by name. Edit it to your own.
